execution.note: sequential sampling APIs; thread environment recorded, actual native thread count not instrumented
execution.api_mode: one batch call per phase for SciPy/R, Python loop returning the same number of tables for urn
execution.timing_scope: setup includes margin processing/sampler and RNG construction; native per-call scratch setup stays in draw cost; imports excluded
execution.r_timer: as.numeric(Sys.time()), wall elapsed clock; small batches amortize timer granularity
execution.shared_host_activity: not isolated or instrumented; timings are observations on one shared host

scipy_exact_pmf_crosscheck.check: every table in two small fibers, not just sampled moments
